body:
Required: `project`, `id` — written together by `zmux attach` from the pair the caller gives, and the reason the name is derivable rather than parsed (d-naming).

Interpreted: `state`, whose only value the reader acts on is `blocked` (needs a human). `working` and `done` are permitted advertisements for agents that want to say so, but the reader builds no ordering on them and a stale one costs nothing. Absent `state` means unknown and is displayed as unknown, never as idle.

Freeform and uninterpreted: every other key — `role`, `note`, `claim`, a tag board — is stored, displayed and counted, never reasoned about. A freeform token costs nothing because it needs no reader change; a new interpreted key must earn one.

Rules:
- Lowercase keys and values; single tokens (e-labels-tokens), so prose lives in history, not labels.
- One fact, one home: never duplicate `state` in the name, and never re-derive `project` from the name once labels exist.
- Written by the session, not by an observer: only the program inside can honestly say it is blocked. A watcher writing state is a daemon with an opinion, refused in q-lazy.
- Absence is data: no `project` means ungrouped, and ungrouped is shown as ungrouped.
title: Vocabulary: two required keys, one interpreted value
